cases.name: Ashley Paige Krebsbach Fish
cases.about:
Melissa Thibodeaux, a former teacher who once taught Fish, recalled her as a sweet and shy girl who became friends with Thibodeaux’s own children.

Her obituary said, "Ashley always had a smile that would light up a room and always had a big bear hug to greet you.  She loved to cook and play the guitar. Ashley also loved flowers and had a green thumb. She was a perfectionist and her “rows were always straight”. Her greatest joy was being mommy and she loved singing with her children while riding in the car. Ashley was the ultimate volunteer mom; she was always first to sign up for any field trips or outings and loved attending her children’s soccer games, gymnastic events and all school programs."
